reconstructed_theorem_text:
For any real inner-product space E,any real kappa and any pair z=(x,p) in E x E,define the real-valued function
  Q_kappa(x,p)=(1/(2kappa)+1/2)||x||^2+<x,p>+||p||^2.
This is a definition with unrestricted real kappa,not a theorem assuming kappa>=1. The norms and inner product are those of E. The cross coefficient is exactly 1. No positivity,coercivity,metric or probability property is asserted by the definition.
objects: Real inner-product E;real kappa;phase pair (x,p);real quadratic expression Q_kappa using two squared norms and their real inner product.
domains: E is a real inner-product space. kappa in R and z in E x E. Q:R x (E x E)->R. No completeness,finite-dimensionality,measurable structure or probability measure is required.
quantifiers: A definition for every real kappa and every z in E x E over every E with the specified structure. No quantified implication,existential object or kappa lower-bound condition occurs.
assumptions: Only the real inner-product structure and well-typed inputs. kappa is unrestricted,including zero or negative values under total Lean real division. No kappa>=1 hypothesis is part of this definition.
conclusion: The assigned value is exactly (1/(2kappa)+1/2)||x||^2+<x,p>+||p||^2. This is the function body rather than a positivity or comparison proposition.
scopes: The expression is a real quadratic form on coordinate pairs with cross coefficient 1. It is not the ordinary max-product norm squared or the coordinate-sum norm squared. Without extra hypotheses the definition itself certifies no norm,metric,nonnegativity or transport property. No material ambiguity is present.
constant_dependencies: Position coefficient 1/(2kappa)+1/2,cross coefficient 1,momentum coefficient 1. Only kappa and the supplied vector pair determine the value;no hidden parameter,dimension constant or probability law occurs.
